name: Forest Pixie
description: A glowing green fairy that whispers luck and healing words.

ability.name: Pixie Dust
ability.description: Sprinkles magical dust to heal you for 10 HP.

name: Moon Rabbit
description: A fluffy rabbit said to live on the moon, bringing good fortune.

ability.name: Lucky Carrot
ability.description: Feeds you a lucky carrot, restoring 12 HP.

name: Fire Imp
description: A tiny, naughty demon with a hot temper.

name: Crystal Wisp
description: A floating orb of crystal light that acts as a shield.

ability.name: Shield Glow
ability.description: Gives a defensive shield, boosting defense by 4 for 2 turns.

name: Shadow Cat
description: A mysterious feline that walks between shadows.

ability.name: Shadow Scratch
ability.description: Deals 20 damage and applies a minor bleeding debuff (3 dmg/turn for 2 turns).

name: Storm Eagle
description: A majestic eagle that channels electric wind.

ability.name: Thunder Strike
ability.description: Strikes the target with lightning, dealing 25 damage.

name: Ancient Golem
description: A small rock construct made from ancient mossy ruins.

ability.name: Granite Armor
ability.description: Hardens skin, increasing defense by 6 for 3 turns.

name: Ice Phoenix
description: A beautiful bird made of eternal ice, freezing enemies with its aura.

ability.name: Glacial Aura
ability.description: Freezes the enemy, dealing 30 damage and reducing their speed by 5 for 2 turns.

name: Void Hatchling
description: An infant dragon from the void, devouring magical spells.

ability.name: Void Devour
ability.description: Deals 35 damage and drains 10 mana from the enemy to heal your mana.

name: Golden Dragon
description: The ultimate symbol of wealth and power, breathing golden flames.
